milestone: V0.9 Product Runtime / Unified Goal API
progress: V0.8 graduated; V0.9.1 Unified Goal Service contract and tests committed; V0.9 branch CI enabled
execution_step: Run full regression CI for the product-facing one-request service boundary
execution_detail: UnifiedGoalService now exposes one stable submit_goal(GoalSubmissionRequest) boundary above the proven V0.8 orchestration. It accepts natural-language goal text plus optional goal_id, success criteria, constraints and priority, then delegates to Goal Intake -> Skill routing -> durable Supervisor launch -> automatic recovery handoff. The returned GoalSubmissionResult contains goal_id, selected skill_id, final/current status, handoff flag, resume cursor and a product-facing message. The service is transport-agnostic so HTTP/CLI/UI adapters will not duplicate orchestration logic.
current_work: Verify V0.9.1 UnifiedGoalService and its fail-closed duplicate-goal semantics against the full regression suite.
next_step: If CI is green, mark V0.9.1 DONE and build V0.9.2 Goal Query / Status / Events service so clients can retrieve durable goal state without reading JSON files directly.
finish_line: V0.9 completes when the proven autonomous orchestration is exposed as a stable always-on product runtime with goal submission, query/status/events, pause/cancel/resume boundaries, and a real local service E2E.
user_action: None. Keep the V0.9 watcher open.
